description: Record a live demo of the connected product tailored to one new lead (their goal, company, and tools) before the first sales call, for example when a CRM or demo form receives a new lead. DemoPage runs the demo in a browser in the background and alerts the team when it is ready; if the link is set to send prepared demos to leads, the lead gets it by email too. It counts as one live demo on the plan once it shows at least two pages, and needs a plan that includes demos before the first call (Growth or above) with the feature turned on in Demo settings. Confirm with the user before calling it for a real lead. Send the same idempotency_key when retrying.

examples.goal: See how invoice approvals work for a 40-person finance team before Friday's call.
examples.name: Ada

external_id.description: The lead's id in the CRM, echoed back on the team's alert.

goal.description: What the lead wants to solve or see, in their words, for example the message from the demo form.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key when you retry the same request: the first result comes back and nothing runs twice. Keys last 24 hours.

name.description: The lead's first or full name.

tools.description: Tools the lead uses today, for example "HubSpot, Slack".

name: demopage_prepare_demo
title: Record a personalized product demo for a new lead
